title: Running the primary experiment
outcome: Explain running the primary experiment using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Run the frozen experiment. A research team freezes versions A and B, labels and scoring before a six-case primary run.
given: A scores [1,0,1,1,0,1]; B scores [1,1,1,0,1,1]. Both answer the same six cases. Binary entries mean 1=correct and 0=incorrect.

steps.label: Keep versions fixed
steps.detail: No case result may trigger tuning during this run.

steps.label: Keep case-level records
steps.detail: Cases two and five favour B; case four favours A.

explanation: Running the primary experiment means following the declared protocol and retaining raw outcomes. Overall scores alone hide different failure patterns.

counterfactual.change: Tune B after inspecting its case-four failure, then rescore the same set.
counterfactual.prediction: Label the rerun as development on exposed cases, not untouched primary evaluation.
counterfactual.reason: The evaluation outcomes have now influenced the version.

student_task: Compute A’s and B’s six-case counts and identify the cases that favour each. How must a B revision tuned on case four be labelled when evaluated again on the same set?
teacher_answer: No case result may trigger tuning during this run. A totals 4/6; B totals 5/6. Cases two and five favour B; case four favours A. Changed case: Label the rerun as development on exposed cases, not untouched primary evaluation. The evaluation outcomes have now influenced the version.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: Six illustrative cases do not establish a population advantage or statistical significance.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
